review_context.scope: Visual inspection of all 17 actual-PPTX PNG exports, individually, plus a contact sheet. This is not native Office or screen-reader validation.
review_context.renderer: First-party artifact-tool imports the skill-built PPTX and exports PNG; LibreOffice unavailable.
review_context.supplemental_renderer_completion_evidenc: All 17 PNGs and the final hash manifest were written before the nonzero process exit. Each image was opened for inspection.

findings.message: Chinese paragraphs were rewritten into short semantic lines; tables fit without reducing the body font below the selected readability contract.
Seven technical figures were re-laid out on a 1200x430 canvas, replacing smaller tall figures; final preview arrows, labels, amounts and receipt references are legible.
The architecture explicitly identifies sessions.sqlite3, agent.sqlite3 and bank.sqlite3. Generic panel A labels were replaced with descriptive Chinese labels.
Final slides contain substantive project content, six native tables, two native method flows, source footers and notes; no clipping or obstructed labels were seen.
Native PowerPoint/WPS and LibreOffice rendering were not performed; font substitution and Office-specific behavior remain unverified.
The static accessibility audit retains four warnings: table context on slides 8, 11 and 14, and a generic-alt-text heuristic on slide 9. No screen-reader certification is claimed.
